resource.name: shumai
resource.creator: shumaiOne
resource.category: Productivity scripts, workflow bridges, and integrations
resource.description: Self-hosted creative asset review and collaboration server with video previews, timestamped feedback and project management. Version 0.4.5 adds comment export for Resolve and other NLEs, space-key previews and comment-count badges. Hosting and optional AI services have separate requirements.
resource.access: Free; hosting and AI services separate
resource.platformNotes: Docker Compose or npm deployment; PostgreSQL with pgvector required for npm setup. Optional AI services have separate requirements.

requirements.dependencies: Docker Compose, or npm with PostgreSQL/pgvector

evidence.note: Docker Compose or npm deployment; PostgreSQL with pgvector required for npm setup. Optional AI services have separate requirements.
Recorded provider release evidence, not installation testing.

history.name: shumaiOne/shumai
history.summary: Adds email notifications, VA-API transcoding and software fallback, and improves poster-frame and sprite generation.
changes: Adds batched email notification digests and configurable SMTP settings.
Adds VA-API acceleration with software fallback when hardware encoding fails.
Improves poster selection and large-video sprite generation.

history.name: shumaiOne/shumai
history.summary: Adds HDR proxy generation and playback support, a documentation changelog, and fixes playback, rotation and daemon behaviour.
changes: Adds HDR video proxies and supported-display playback with tone-mapped SDR thumbnails.
Fixes initial-playback overlays, rotated-video aspect ratios and foreground PID handling; improves proxy quality and frame seeking.

history.name: shumaiOne/shumai
history.summary: Adds NLE comment export, including Resolve, and faster preview navigation.
changes: Exports feedback to Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Premiere and Media Composer.
Adds space-key previews and comment-count badges.
